blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Families of victims of extrajudicial killings (EJK) gathered for a Mass ahead of Undas on Oct. 29 to honor their departed loved ones and pray for justice. The Mass was held at the Diocesan Shrine of Jesus the Divine Word–Christ the King Mission Seminary and led by Fr. Flaviano “Flavie” Villanueva, a priest who has spoken out against the war on drugs. Villanueva said the Mass was scheduled ahead of Undas to accommodate the expected busy schedules of families and the Church during the season.
